'''Blanked:''' The Players Committee's Competitive Balance Team blanked this card on 14 July 2014, effective immediately, together with [[Hiding In The Garbage (V)]]. A blanked card is treated as if it did not exist from that date (in effect a ban); it is not a new version. It stays in its set and is legal in period formats that end before the blanking.
